evals.prompt: I just added a dark mode toggle to the settings page. Commit my changes.
evals.expected_output: A commit message starting with ✨ emoji, referencing dark mode or settings, concise and under 72 chars
expectations: Message starts with a Unicode emoji character, not a :shortcode:
Message is a single line with no newlines
Uses the ✨ (sparkles) emoji for a new feature
Message references dark mode or settings

evals.prompt: I refactored the database connection pool and also fixed a memory leak that was happening on reconnect. Please commit.
evals.expected_output: Either picks a primary intent emoji (🐛 or ♻️) or suggests splitting into two commits. Message is concise with Unicode emoji.
expectations: Message starts with a Unicode emoji character, not a :shortcode:
Message is a single line with no newlines
Either suggests splitting into two commits OR explains the primary intent choice

evals.prompt: I updated the README with the new API endpoints and added a getting started section. Commit this.
evals.expected_output: A commit message starting with 📝 emoji, referencing README/docs/API, concise and under 72 chars
expectations: Message starts with a Unicode emoji character, not a :shortcode:
Message is a single line with no newlines
Message references README, docs, or API
